Product Specifications

Product No.

SST-ST85F-GS

Color

Black (lead-free paint)

Max. DC Output

850W

Power density

V1: 439W per liter  
V2: 471W per liter

V1: 150W  
V2: 120W

Combined +12V

V1: 840W  
V2: 850W

Input Voltage

90V~264V

Input Frequency Range

47Hz ~ 63Hz

PFC

Active PFC.（PF>0.95 at Full Load）

Efficiency

87%~90% at 20%~100% loading

MTBF

100,000 hours

Operating temperature

0°C ~ 40°C

Protection

Over current protection  
Over power protection  
Over voltage protection  
Over temperature protection  
Under voltage protection  
Short circuit protection

Connectors

V1:  
1 x 24 / 20-Pin motherboard connector（550mm）  
1 x 8 / 4-Pin EPS / ATX 12V connector（750mm）  
1 x 8 / 4-Pin EPS / ATX 12V connector（550mm）  
4 x 8/6-Pin PCIE connector（550mm）  
8 x SATA connector（"600mm / 150mm / 150mm / 150mm" x 2）  
6 x 4-Pin Peripheral connector（"600mm / 150mm / 150mm" x 2）  
2 x 4-Pin Floppy connector（”600mm / 150mm / 150mm / 150mm” x 2）  
----------------  
V2:  
1 x 24 / 20-Pin motherboard connector（600mm）  
1 x 8 / 4-Pin EPS / ATX 12V connector（750mm）  
1 x 8 / 4-Pin EPS / ATX 12V connector（550mm）  
4 x 8/6-Pin PCIE connector（”550mm/150mm” x 2）  
2 x 8/6-Pin PCIE connector (550mm x 2)   
8 x SATA connector（"600mm /150mm / 150mm / 150mm" x 2）  
6 x 4-Pin Peripheral connector（”600mm / 150mm / 150mm” x 2）   
2 x 4-Pin Floppy connector（100mm x 2）

Cooling System

Single 120mm silent fan

Noise Level

18 dBA minimum

Certification

80 PLUS Gold

Form factor

ATX

Dimension

V1: 150 mm (W) x 86 mm (H) x 150 mm (D)  
V2: 150 mm (W) x 86 mm (H) x 140 mm (D)

Weight

V1: 2.5 kg  
V2: 1.55 kg
